rationale: A is more decision-useful because it gives a clearer operational strategy: start simple, run sensitivity analysis, add complexity only where measured accuracy gains justify it, and validate against benchmarks. That is directly actionable for parameter selection. B has stronger framing of alternatives and caveats, especially around modular architecture and team capacity, but it is less discriminating about how to decide which parameters deserve complexity now. Neither provides real quantitative evidence beyond general claims, so both score low there. Overall, A better helps a careful user make the immediate parameter-strategy choice, while B is better on governance and implementation context.
